subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept stricter Signal `requireMention=true` behavior for existing groups that have configured bot identity but no text mention regexes?
rationale: The implementation is clean and proven, but merging it can intentionally reduce group message delivery for existing native-only Signal configurations after upgrade.

options.title: Accept stricter native gating
options.body: Merge after acknowledging that configured Signal bot identity should make native-only `requireMention=true` groups enforce mention gating.

options.title: Require compatibility first
options.body: Ask for an opt-in, doctor warning, migration note, or stronger upgrade warning before changing existing native-only groups from pass-through to gated delivery.

options.title: Pause for broader channel policy
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the downstream mention-facts and source-actor stack reviewed as one larger channel-policy package first.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter native gating
recommendation.body: Merge after acknowledging that configured Signal bot identity should make native-only `requireMention=true` groups enforce mention gating.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the shared mention-decision contract and recent Signal group mention-gating defaults.
